title: Design, regioselective, time gated synthesis of novel benzo[d]imidazole analogues as potential quorum sensing inhibitors targeting LasR in Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
authors: Mohammed, Esraa Z; Rateb, Heba S; Helwa, Amira A; Naga, Nourhan G; Mabrouk, Mona E M; Mehany, Ahmed B M; Abdel Aziz, Hatem A; El-Dydamony, Nehad M
one_liner_zh: 该文合成苯并咪唑类似物作为群体感应抑制剂靶向LasR蛋白，虽含MD模拟但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: The rapid emergence of antibiotic-resistant pathogens highlights the crucial need for alternate anti-infective strategies. Quorum sensing inhibition (QSI) offers compelling approaches to attenuate bacterial virulence while limiting the resistance. In this study, fourteen Benzo[d]imidazole derivatives were synthesized and proposed as potential LasR antagonists exhibiting quorum-sensing inhibitory activity. Among these, compounds 7f, 7 h, 11b, 11c, and 11f demonstrated a marked ability to suppress biofilm formation in P. aeruginosa by (83%, 87%, 84%, 87%, 86%), pyocyanin production (76%, 84%, 86%, 82%, 81%), and motility activity; swimming (90%, 86%, 91%, 88%, 90%), twitching (90%, 94%, 93%, 86%, 92%), respectively. Additionally, compounds 7f and 11c effectively inhibited LasR, with IC(50) values equal to 0.74 +/- 0.005, 0.79 +/- 0.001 muM, respectively. Moreover, a 200-ns molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) of the 7f analogue indicated its potential to disrupt the dimeric structure of the LasR protein, thereby confirming its inhibitory activity toward LasR. Collectively, these results establish benzo[d]imidazole scaffolds as promising leads for the development of next-generation quorum sensing modulators aimed at disarming bacterial pathogenicity and countering antimicrobial resistance.
abstract_zh: 抗生素耐药性病原体的快速出现凸显了对替代性抗感染策略的迫切需求。群体感应抑制（QSI）提供了减弱细菌毒力同时限制耐药性的有效方法。在本研究中，合成了十四种苯并[d]咪唑衍生物，并将其作为潜在的LasR拮抗剂，表现出群体感应抑制活性。其中，化合物7f、7h、11b、11c和11f显著抑制了铜绿假单胞菌生物膜形成（分别为83%、87%、84%、87%、86%）、绿脓菌素产生（分别为76%、84%、86%、82%、81%）及运动活性；泳动（分别为90%、86%、91%、88%、90%）、蹭行（分别为90%、94%、93%、86%、92%）。此外，化合物7f和11c有效抑制LasR，其IC(50)值分别为0.74 ± 0.005、0.79 ± 0.001 μM。进一步地，对7f类似物进行的200纳秒分子动力学模拟（MDS）表明其具有破坏LasR蛋白二聚体结构的潜力，从而证实了其对LasR的抑制活性。综合来看，这些结果确立了苯并[d]咪唑骨架作为开发下一代群体感应调节剂的有前景的先导化合物，旨在解除细菌致病性并对抗抗菌药物耐药性。
